label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~70), boosted by recent rewards
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2) and almost only late in the 100-trial episode: zero before trial 30, rate rising from 5% at trials 60-69 to 21% at trials 80-99 (77% of mass in trials 80-99). Within late GO steps it is stronger after a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward=1 holds 82% of mass) and builds over runs of rewarded trials, dropping out after an unrewarded one. It correlates with low model value (value < 7.1 holds 92% of mass) and with an extreme policy logit, i.e. a confident choice. Choice, state, transition and the hidden good state have little effect. Late-episode GO alone gives F1 0.67 / mass recall 0.92; adding the reward clause gives dev F1 0.70 / mass recall 0.89. Precision stays near 0.6 because many late GO steps are inactive, especially after unrewarded trials. Uses only observed variables (an internal sense of elapsed time plus the observed previous reward). Best read as an episode-time ramp at GO, gated by recent reward.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S1 r, a1 S1 r, a1 S1 u) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 r, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
